## What F1 data do you want to expose?

A clear description of the data or capability you'd like added.

## Which FastF1 API would back this?

Link or describe the FastF1 method (e.g. `session.laps`, `fastf1.ergast.fetch_...`).

## Year coverage

Which seasons does this data cover? (FastF1 telemetry: 2018-present; Ergast API: 1950-present)

## Use case

How would you use this in an AI workflow or conversation?

## Anything else

Related issues, PRs, or FastF1 docs links.
